questions.question: What is a data structure?

options.text: A way to store and organize data

questions.explanation: Data structures organize data for efficient access and modification.

questions.question: Which data structure follows FIFO?
questions.explanation: Queue follows First In First Out.

questions.question: Which data structure follows LIFO?
questions.explanation: Stack follows Last In First Out.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of accessing an array element by index?
questions.explanation: Array indexing is constant time.

questions.question: Which data structure uses nodes with pointers?
questions.explanation: Linked lists store data using nodes and pointers.

questions.question: Which operation is faster in a linked list than an array?
questions.explanation: Insertion at head is O(1) in linked list.

questions.question: What is a tree?
questions.explanation: Trees represent hierarchical relationships.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of children in a binary tree node?
questions.explanation: Binary tree nodes have at most two children.

questions.question: Which traversal visits root first?
questions.explanation: Preorder traversal visits root first.

questions.question: What is a graph?
questions.explanation: Graphs consist of vertices and edges.

questions.question: Which algorithm is used for searching in sorted array?
questions.explanation: Binary search works on sorted arrays.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of binary search?
questions.explanation: Binary search halves the search space.

questions.question: Which sorting algorithm has best average time complexity?
questions.explanation: Quick sort has O(n log n) average complexity.

questions.question: Which sorting algorithm is stable?
questions.explanation: Merge sort preserves relative order.

questions.question: What is recursion?
questions.explanation: Recursion occurs when a function calls itself.

questions.question: What is base case in recursion?
questions.explanation: Base case prevents infinite recursion.

questions.question: Which data structure is used for BFS?
questions.explanation: BFS uses a queue.

questions.question: Which data structure is used for DFS?
questions.explanation: DFS uses stack or recursion.

questions.question: What is a heap?
questions.explanation: Heap is a complete binary tree.

questions.question: Which heap is used in priority queue?
questions.explanation: Priority queues can use min or max heaps.

questions.question: What is time complexity?

options.text: Growth of algorithm time with input size

questions.explanation: Time complexity measures growth rate.

questions.question: What does Big-O represent?
questions.explanation: Big-O represents worst-case complexity.

questions.question: Which is NOT a linear data structure?
questions.explanation: Tree is non-linear.

questions.question: What is hashing?
questions.explanation: Hashing maps keys to indices.

questions.question: Which data structure is best for fast lookup?
questions.explanation: Hash tables provide near O(1) lookup.
